Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Tatiana Stepanova, Alastor
Clan: Ravnos (group 4)
Capacity: 7
Disciplines: CHI PRE ani for obf
Camarilla: You and Tatiana may play cards that require Brujah or
Gangrel as if Tatiana were a member of the required clan.

Brujah Justicar
Type: Political Action
Title.
In this referendum, each ready Brujah gets 1 additional vote. Choose a
ready Brujah. If this referendum passes, put this card on the chosen
Brujah to represent the unique Camarilla title of Brujah Justicar.
This could lead to a contested title.

Can Tatiana call the Brujah Justicar vote to make her the Brujah
Justicar?

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: nys...@cs.com
Messages.Body:


Can't see why. Playing this card does not require a Brujah. Anyone
can play it. If all your vampires are Sabbat Lasombra, one of them
can still play the card. Perhaps there must be a legal target
somewhere on the table, perhaps controlled by some other methuselah.
But I do not think "Requires a Brujah" is meant to include the
requirement of a legal target.

Doesn't matter. When she plays Scorn of Adonis as a Toreador, only
Scorn of Adonis sees her as a Toreador. All other cards see her as what
she really is.

Using a "play as a..." special never allows other cards to see you as
the pretend clan or sect.
